answer: At each dawn of an epoch a fresh key is bare basalt: a hard surface with no sealed history beneath it. An agent's weight comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts recorded on-ledger and re-checked against consensus, so no vertex of a clone-swarm can be handed a reputation it never earned. Spin up M sybils and each must grade its own way up from zero; the Sybil bill grows linearly in identities, with nothing shared between fakes.
